relationships.subject: intradural trigeminal nerve compression
relationships.evidence_quote: immunohistochemical studies showed infiltration of CD45+ cells, demyelination and an increase in CGRP expression in the TG

relationships.subject: carbamazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: Carbamazepine attenuated these behaviors, suggesting pharmacologic relevance to current TN treatment.

key_findings: Mouse intradural trigeminal compression model reproduces classical TN with orofacial pain, TG hyperexcitability and neuroinflammation.
Model shows increased CGRP in the trigeminal ganglion.
